name: MonarchSaveStatusIndicator
title: SaveStatusIndicator
wrapsNative: Label with a ProgressView or SF Symbol icon, in TimelineView(.everyMinute), and MonarchButton for retry
summary: A small inline status for saving: "Unsaved changes", "Saving…", "Saved · 2 minutes ago" or "Couldn't save" with a retry button.
whenToUse: In an editor's toolbar or next to a form's buttons, wherever edits are saved in the background.
whenNotToUse: For the freshness of data the app fetched, use MonarchFreshnessIndicator. For a one-off confirmation after a button press, use a toast.
api: init(_ status: MonarchSaveStatus, savedAt: Date? = nil, errorMessage: String? = nil, announcesSaving: Bool = false, labels: MonarchSaveStatusIndicatorLabels = MonarchSaveStatusIndicatorLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
enum MonarchSaveStatus { case idle, unsaved, saving, saved, error }
struct MonarchSaveStatusIndicatorLabels { var unsaved, saving, saved, error, retry: String? }

options.name: status
options.description: idle (nothing drawn), unsaved, saving, saved or error.

options.name: savedAt
options.description: When the last save finished; shown as relative time after "Saved".

options.name: announcesSaving
options.description: Also announces "Saving…". Off by default so autosaves stay quiet.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds a retry button to the error status.

states.name: unsaved
states.description: A small dot in the warning colour and "Unsaved changes".

states.name: saved
states.description: A check mark in the success colour, "Saved" and the relative time.

states.name: error
states.description: A warning triangle and the text in the danger colour, with a retry button when onRetry is given.

appearance: Caption text in the muted text colour. Icons take the strong colour of their meaning: warning for unsaved, success for saved, danger for error, where the text is also in the danger colour.
platformNotes: The web announces through a polite live region; iOS posts an announcement, which VoiceOver may speak over other speech. Android shares the name and the statuses.
accessibility: The icon and words are a standard Label, read with the time as one element; the icon is decorative and the words carry the meaning.
When the status turns saved or error, the outcome is announced; saving is announced only with announcesSaving.
The retry button is a separate standard button with a 44-point touch target.
edgeCases: The relative time is redrawn every minute.
The same outcome twice in a row (saved, then saved again) is not announced again, because the status did not change; set the status to saving in between.
An empty errorMessage falls back to "Couldn't save".
